description: Approve or decline a pending OpenVibe.Domains proposal for its person (plan 2026-10-28 §5.1: no change touches DNS until its person approves it): POST /api/v1/proposals/:id/decide { decision: approve | decline } with a service token and X-OV-Subject naming the proposal's owner, the same decision the person makes on the proposal's page. Approving applies the change through the provider's API with the person's connected credential; the proposal keeps its rollback. Granted to OpenVibe.Network, which acts from the Action Center for the signed-in person.
